title: Live-sports habitat rankings and the frozen L5 shadow, both venues
labels: READ-ONLY / SHADOW-HYPOTHETICAL. No orders, no arming, no live capital. No Model A change and no habitat threshold change.
KEY_FINDING: BOOK REACH AND TRADED FLOW ARE NOT THE SAME THING, and the gap is the whole story. The reach metric measures the ask descending to your bid, which quote revision alone can produce. A fill needs an actual PRINT. On the top-ranked habitats only 0-14% of 4-second intervals contain any trade at all: wta-barthel-stefano, the single best International habitat by reach (77.5% at 120s, 52.9 recycles/hour), had ONE print in 67 intervals over 5.1 minutes. The frozen policy confirms it -- 14 possible fills, ZERO opposite fills, ZERO matched pairs. Reach is an UPPER BOUND on fill opportunity, not a measure of it.
heterogeneity_is_real_and_averaging_dest: PMUS live pooled reads 23.8% reach@120s. Inside it, PMUS|sea|soccer_team_full_game_total is 71.5% on n=144 and aec-atpcq-lucwie-kaiweh is 59.7% on n=72. INTL|wta|moneyline is 77.5% and the individual market INTL|lol-fue-edgy is 90.9% -- ABOVE the International BTC15m reference of 80.6%. The venue-wide number is not a property of any market in it.
distance_metric_correction: The latency term is now SCALED BY THE REACH RATE. Median time-to-reach is conditioned on reaching at all, so a market reaching 5% of the time with a fast median is not close to the reference. Unscaled, PMUS|sea|spread (5.0% reach, 21s median) ranked SECOND. This corrects the metric's definition; no habitat threshold moved.
reach_definition: CANONICAL, verbatim from the run that produced 08d9fc8b. Right-censored states EXCLUDED, never scored as misses.

new_metric_definitions.two_sided: % of states where BOTH directions reach inside 120s.
new_metric_definitions.recycle_per_hr: NON-OVERLAPPING buy-reach events per observed hour; the scan resumes AT the hit so one long wait is never counted many times.

SHADOW.labels: SHADOW/HYPOTHETICAL. No order exists. Every fill is the frozen module's `possible` class -- an UPPER BOUND, queue position UNPROVEN. Nothing is submitted, filled, settled or realized.
SHADOW.fee_treatment: PMUS maker fee is ZERO. The maker REBATE is credited by the venue but is NEVER counted here and never merged into trading P&L. No rebate or reward is assumed on either venue.

cohort_roles.INTL: REFERENCE/FIDELITY on L5's own venue -- not executable for us, never a trading target

caveats: Shadow spans are 2.9-5.1 minutes per market. This is EARLY and the zero matched conversion is not yet a settled result.
Every shadow fill is the frozen module's `possible` class: an upper bound confirmed by a later print at or through the resting price, QUEUE POSITION UNPROVEN.
Volume is LUMPY, not continuous: wta shows 1551 shares/min from a single print. That is the opposite of the L5 source habitat, which runs ~900 matched contracts per BTC15m window.
INTL and PMUS cohorts are never pooled. INTL is reference/fidelity on L5's own venue, which we do not execute on; PMUS is transfer/executability.
book_stale refusals in the shadow are markets dropped by a reselect, i.e. the frozen module correctly refusing a stale book -- not a defect.
